items.label: BUBBLE MOWING FUN
items.value: An awesome toy that will have that kiddo bubbly with glee! This lawn mower doubles as a bubble blower machine kids will love. It comes with 3 bottles of bubble solution to fuel the fun. Just insert 3 x AA batteries (not included), and watch it produce a barrage of beautiful bubbles

items.label: FUEL THEIR IMAGINATION
items.value: This 18” lawnmower doesn’t just blow bubbles, it also produces realistic sound effects to amplify the fun; wheels have the gear sounds when pushing. Indoors or outdoors, it will keep kids happily busy. The moving and walking about is a fun way for little ones to get in some healthy exercise

items.label: GREAT QUALITY
items.value: We know just how enthusiastic the play can get. That’s why we’ve designed our bubble lawn mower using durable plastic to withstand it all. It’s very easy to assemble, and the handle can be detached for easy and space-friendly storage

items.label: AWESOME GIFT IDEA
items.value: Looking for a fun birthday gift for boys and girls? A cool holiday gift for that adorable toddler? Treat them to this bubble blowing push mower toy and watch them beam. It’s the perfect bubbly treat for 1, 2, 3, and 4 year-olds

items.label: WATCH THEM LEARN
items.value: Bubble toys don’t just add a touch of magic to sunny days, they also help kids effortlessly pick up crucial skills as they play. They’ll get to hone gross motor skills as they chase & pop bubbles, and visual tracking skills as they watch bubbles float away
